people.name: Nam Hong Ju
people.note: SBC field reporter who sees the future in her dreams; 'Bamtori' as a tomboy

people.name: Lee Yu Beom
people.note: Prosecutor turned lawyer, who fabricates whatever wins

people.name: Han U Tak
people.note: Model police officer hiding his colour-blindness

people.name: Choi Dam Dong
people.note: Veteran investigator, once a police officer

people.name: Son Woo Joo
people.note: Senior prosecutor; a single mother, her son Chan Ho played by Ko Woo Rim

links.label: new neighbours who begin sharing dreams of the future, and fall in love
links.evidence: An unusual dream involving Hong Ju, ruthless attorney Lee Yu Beom, and a life-saving intervention leads Jae Chan to realize their destinies are intertwined, as they begin sharing dreams / She later in the series falls in love with Jae-chan and begins dating him.

links.label: 'Bamtori' — the 'boy' who pulled him from the lake and passed him her dreams, the day of their fathers' joint funeral
links.evidence: without knowing or recognising that she was "Bamtori", his childhood acquaintance who also lost her father to the runaway soldier / By saving Jae-chan from drowning, she had inadvertently made Jae-chan acquire the same ability that she has.

links.label: her boyfriend from a blind date, until the night of the accident
links.evidence: He was Hong-joo's boyfriend because of a blind date. However, they broke up after Jae-chan saved her from the accident that night.

links.label: his teenage tutor, who left him at a motorcycle crash; now the lawyer fabricating evidence across from him
links.evidence: Yoo-beom was Jae-chan's private tutor when Jae-chan was in his adolescence. […] he leaves Jae-chan behind to fend for himself, an incident which made Jae-chan dislike him. / As a lawyer, he works in Haekwang Law Firm […] fabricating evidence or manipulating testimonies

links.label: grows fond of her, and keeps it to himself
links.evidence: Woo-tak began having an affection for Hong-joo, although he kept his feelings concealed, sensing that Hong-joo and Jae-chan are developing feelings for each other.

links.label: saved by him from the crash he was fated to die in; caught the dreams from him
links.evidence: Thanks to Jae-chan, who intercepted Hong-joo's car which Yoo-beom was driving, he was saved from his supposed death and acquired from him the ability to see future events through dreams.

links.label: senior at the substation, who noticed his colour-blindness and kept it quiet
links.evidence: 상구지구대 경위. 우탁의 선배 / he sensed that Woo-tak had color blindness but kept the secret to himself to prevent Woo-tak from getting discharged

links.label: fellow officer with a crush on him
links.evidence: 한우탁을 짝사랑하는 여경찰 / Police officer who has a crush on Han Woo-tak

links.label: becomes a mother figure to him, U Tak and Seung Won
